name: Rizuhble's Drive-By Vindicta
rows: Getting poked out in lane. Back off before you use it. Sell it once you're out of slots.
Lash ult, Infernus ult. Anything big you can see coming.
Get after Leech if needed. Ahead? Skip it until you're dying. Sell Swift Striker for it.
Their gun heroes shoot you out of the sky.
Most of their damage is gun.
Most of their damage is spirit.
Stuns and Knockdown keep dropping you out of Flight.
Slows and hexes keep landing on you.
If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.
changes: No mine/vindicta.txt exists, so the style check is against the public pure-gun builds (lockbuilds 'turbo absolute gun vindicta' and 'Witch With a Sniper', tracklock core, pro list). Early/mid kept: HV + Long Range → Sharpshooter (pro 63%), Extra Charge → Rapid Recharge (95%/87%), Quicksilver → Mercurial Magnum on Flight, Swift Striker/Burst Fire, Titanic, Enduring Speed (57%).

Crippling Headshot cut from core (6.4k fresh T4 at 51.2k, in none of the pure-gun builds) and Toxic Bullets swapped for Duration Extender → Superior Duration on Flight (tracklock core, pro 28% late): Flight is 23s at T2, Superior Duration makes it ~29s of air time with Magnum bullets. Duration Extender bought mid (19.2k) so it isn't a fresh T2 late.

Blood Tribute added late (41.6k): 'Witch With a Sniper' and turbo both run it next to Leech, and Leech's 28% bullet lifesteal out-heals the 50/s drain while you shoot. It's the Lucky Shot sell in rich.
Counterspell moved to the top of the counters (pro 71% mid, 'buy it every game' in the Witch build).
Core 12 slots, 48k (was 51.2k). Spikes unchanged: gun 4.8k at 4.8k souls, health at 12.8k, spirit at 14.4k; Leech lands 8k health at 30.4k.

Ability order: Gun style: Flight T1/T2 at 5-6 (+50% ammo flying, +10s for Duration Extender/Quicksilver/Mercurial on Flight), Assassinate T1/T2 at 7-8 like mobalytics (80/64%) for Extra Charge/Rapid Recharge, Flight T3 at 10, ult T3 (+4% weapon damage per kill) at 11, Crow (T3 bullet-resist shred) 12-14, Stake upgrades last; seemeta most-popular (60.9%) also takes the ult early and Crow/Flight upgrades late.

Item fit: Glass Cannon → Lucky Shot (moved up from the rich box). Glass Cannon isn't in any public Vindicta list checked (tracklock core/situational/probuild, lockbuilds top 30 items, turbo absolute gun and Ace's Vindicta Carry builds) and costs 13% max health on a hero who picks from the air; Lucky Shot is in tracklock late situational and both public carry builds, same 6.4k T4 gun slot, +30% mag on her 19-round gun (0.231s per shot, 2.9s reload).

Item fit: Hollow Point → Counterspell (moved up from Counters). Hollow Point isn't in any public Vindicta list checked. Counterspell is the most bought mid item on pro Vindictas (tracklock probuild mid 71%; lockbuilds 28% pick, avg 21 min) and in both public carry builds; Flight makes her an easy target for stuns and ults. Same 3.2k at the same timing, total unchanged at 48k; gun goes 27.2k→24k.

Item fit: rich box removed. Frenzy isn't in any public Vindicta list checked and its lifesteal/fire rate only kicks in under 50% health, which a flying picker avoids; Lucky Shot moved into the core. Lane box Extra Regen → Healing Rite: Extra Regen isn't in any public Vindicta list; Healing Rite is the lane option in Ace's Vindicta Carry, and she pokes from range so she can back off to use it.

Item fit: Leech kept (lockbuilds 5,067 bought, 54.9% WR; tracklock early situational Bullet Lifesteal) since her Flight bullets and Assassinate do spirit damage; note both public carry builds go Bullet Lifesteal → Vampiric Burst and Spiritual Overflow instead, which is an option if Kieran prefers it.
Order: 3221144411332243 (data-first redo, see a7/order_vindicta.json).

Threshold: checked on the new order, nothing moved. Extra Charge (5.6k) and Rapid Recharge (9.6k) work on Assassinate (2 charges), unlocked at 3.2k and T2 by Extra Charge. Flight imbues bought with Flight T1+.

Round 8: (current patch = Oct 16 2026 Violet release; last change to Vindicta's kit Aug 12 2026 (Stake T1 65→45), last change to items here Sep 16 2026 (Mercurial Magnum base bullet bonus 25%→20%, scaling 0.49→0.38; Leech 25→28%); data used is from after Sep 16: tracklock items page, lockbuilds 'Current Patch', builds updated Oct 1-14). 1) Counterspell out of the core into a 'They have Knockdown?' box next to Early (Sexy Feet Oct 14: 'take an anti-CC item (Counterspell or Dispel) early'; Ace's Vindicta Carry Oct 3: 'Pick 1 Vitality: Counterspell/Dispel'). Its core slot: Rapid Rounds now upgrades to Swift Striker in mid (+20% fire rate; tracklock 72.8% usage, 51.0% WR; Ace's Carry runs Rapid Rounds→Swift Striker and Burst Fire), and Burst Fire is bought outright as the first late item (tracklock 74.7%, 51.9% WR). Core 12 slots, 48k → 46.4k. 2) Quicksilver Reload/Mercurial Magnum moved from Flight to Crow Familiar: charge-up is 18s/14s and isn't cut by cooldown reduction, Flight's cooldown is 42s but Crow's is 16s from T2 (Crow is T2 before Quicksilver is bought), so the reload + fire rate (+10%/+22% for 12s) and Mercurial's bullet bonus come every ~16s instead of every 42s, and Crow's bullet-resist shred lands with it. No current-patch source shows imbue targets (lockbuilds/tracklock/deadlocklabs/deadlocked list items only); only older pro data (deadfrag, aidan ~Jan 2026) shows Mercurial on Crow. Duration Extender stays on Flight (+22% of 23s = +5s; Superior Duration is no longer an imbue, +28% to everything); still bought by a minority (tracklock 15.2%/18.5% usage, lockbuilds 10.1%/13.0%; Superior Duration core in Sexy Feet Oct 14). 3) Blood Tribute kept over Fury Trance: Blood Tribute +35% fire rate all the time (50/s drain), Fury Trance +32% for 6.5s every 18s and silences you and blocks stamina while active, so no Assassinate/Crow/Stake and no Spellslinger stacks; tracklock Blood Tribute 8.9% usage 55.5% WR vs Fury Trance 1.6% 50.7%; Blood Tribute is in turbo gun (Oct 11) and Ace's Carry (Oct 3) cores, Fury Trance only in Ace's survival box. 4) Stamina Mastery not added: +2 stamina, +18% stamina recovery, +23% air dash distance, extra air jump/dash, no damage or health; tracklock 6.7% usage 49.9% WR (Extra Stamina 48.1%), not in any of the 4 recent lockbuilds cores (situational only in turbo Oct 1 and Sexy Feet Oct 14). 5) Recharging Rush not added: 200 in 3.5s is easy (her base gun is 53.4 DPS, ~187 in 3.5s before any item, well over with Sharpshooter at range), but it's a fresh 1.6k with no upgrade, refunds the same Assassinate charges Rapid Recharge already gives (4 charges, -14% cooldown), and is 12.9% usage 49.1% WR on tracklock; none of the 4 recent lockbuilds cores have it (optional in Sexy Feet).

Round 9: Worth a try box: Mystic Reverb on Assassinate (shot is 90 + 0.93x spirit, plus 90 + 2.3x under half health, at Spellslinger's slot (36.8k, ~113 spirit) a full shot is ~195, so every shot clears Reverb's 100 minimum; Reverb repeats 50% of it 3s later with a 32% slow; 2 charges, more with Rapid Recharge).

Round 12: Worth a try box removed; Mystic Reverb (Kieran likes it) and Lightning Scroll now sit in a rich box after the 46.4k core. Numbers at ~37k (112 spirit + 14 from Rapid Recharge on Assassinate = 126): a full Assassinate shot is 90 + 0.93x126 = 207, or 587 on a target under half health. Lightning Scroll adds a flat 150 and a 0.75s stun 3s after the hit, plus a 64% slow for 2s, with no cooldown in the game files. Reverb echoes half the shot 3s later (104, or 293 under half health) onto the target and anyone within 16m, with a 32% slow, once every 6.25s, so about 2 echoes per 4-charge volley. Lightning Scroll goes first: the flat 150 beats Reverb's 104 on a low-spirit gun Vindicta, and the stun and slow line up the next shot. Neither item is in current public Vindicta builds (tracklock pro, last 30 days, 139 games; tracklock build page). Lightning Scroll sells Blood Tribute; Reverb sells Burst Fire.
Round 13: notes emptied per UPDATE 3 (only sells, swaps, slot locked, counters and verified tips kept); desc shortened to a style label (UPDATE 4).

Round 14: renamed Sky Gunner (gun is the style; the snipe build is now the separate Pure Sniper). Counterspell into the core as part of the 4.8k health spike (Kieran: pure gun Vindicta still needs Counterspell; in 5 of 6 post-patch gun builds) in place of Duration Extender → Superior Duration (only Sexy Feet's core); 'They have Knockdown?' box removed. Lightning Scroll and Mystic Reverb moved out of the rich box into the Pure Sniper core (they boost Assassinate, not this build's gun); rich box now Divine Barrier (pricier Dispel Magic). Juggernaut slot-locked upgrade added. Blood Tribute note and Titanic note emptied; Swift Striker gets a sell note; Spirit Resilience note made concrete.
Round 15: Counters desc was 119 characters (game limit 112): now 'Get after Leech … Sell Swift Striker for it.' (107); Titanic Magazine takes the 'Sell it for a counter.' note so each is sold once.
Round 20: late list Spiritual Overflow, Vampiric Burst, Ricochet; Divine Barrier note fixed (Dispel Magic is only a counter). Core+late 70.4k.
Round 23: kit re-read, no item change (see log).
Round 25: ability order 3221144411332243 -> 3322124342311441 (worked out from the kit for this build's playstyle).
